**Exclude deprecated OpenAI models from direct dropdown options.**

The unified `LanguageModel` helper already excludes deprecated models. However, `OpenAIModelComponent` and `CombinatorialReasonerComponent` pass the raw OpenAI name lists to dropdowns. Those lists retain deprecated entries, such as `gpt-4.1-nano`.

Add the deprecated filter to both selectable lists. Keep deprecated entries in `OPENAI_MODELS_DETAILED` for saved-flow metadata resolution.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
 OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_NAMES = [
     metadata["name"]
     for metadata in OPENAI_MODELS_DETAILED
     if not metadata.get("not_supported", False)
     and not metadata.get("reasoning", False)
     and not metadata.get("search", False)
+    and not metadata.get("deprecated", False)
 ]

 OPENAI_REASONING_MODEL_NAMES = [
     metadata["name"]
     for metadata in OPENAI_MODELS_DETAILED
     if metadata.get("reasoning", False) and not metadata.get("not_supported", False)
+    and not metadata.get("deprecated", False)
 ]
```

Good catch, confirmed: `OpenAIModelComponent` and `CombinatorialReasonerComponent` build their dropdowns from `OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_NAMES` / `OPENAI_REASONING_MODEL_NAMES`, which did not filter `deprecated`, so `gpt-4.1-nano`, `o1` etc. were still offered.
Rather than filtering those two lists (the OpenAI component also uses them to decide whether a saved flow's model is a reasoning model), added `OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_OPTIONS` / `OPENAI_REASONING_MODEL_OPTIONS` without deprecated entries and pointed both dropdowns at them. `OPENAI_MODELS_DETAILED` is untouched. Anthropic already filters (`ANTHROPIC_MODELS`). Test added in `test_openai_constants.py`.

CI on this PR showed one failure caused by the change: `test_filter_by_model_name` filters by `gpt-4`, which this PR now marks deprecated, and deprecated models are left out of the list by default, so the filter found nothing. Pushed a one-line fix passing `include_deprecated=True` in that test; `test_unified_models.py::test_filter_by_model_name` fails on the previous head and passes with it. The other failing jobs (`test_telemetry_identity`, `test_workflow_stream_keepalive`, the release plan check and the performance digest) are in areas this PR does not touch.

This comment was drafted with the help of an AI agent (Claude) working on behalf of the PR author.
